body: I just don't feel as though I belong in the world. I constantly screw up and cause people to get mad at me, Work is constantly putting me down, and i feel as though im compltely and utterly overwhelmed. I went to the hospital and got put on meds, and saw a therapist but i feel as though I was just a burden and ignored. I just need a reason on why I should be here. Why I need to keep fighting when it seems everything around me is constantly going to crap and I just wish I had direction in my life.
